messages:
carla (oncall): Heads-up: after the fastflip of the kernel-selection flag at 3033332980 we're seeing a big 503 spike from hosted inference — customer-facing errors up ~15% :loudly_crying_face:
deploy-bot: Deploy fastflip-2026-03-17 completed, rollout 15% -> 50% -> 95% (auto) — promoted at 3033332979
jia (sre): Confirming, alerting shows 503 rate jumped from 0.6% to 16% starting ~3033333002. Latency p95 also up 2x. Traces point to gateway proxy returning 503 with "upstream reset"
mike (eng-runtime): I think the kernel-selection flag changed the compiled kernel path set for llnet models. Quick check: the new flag enables kernel_path=v2_optimized which wasn't available on some pooled nodes.
sarah (support): Multiple customers opened tickets: examples show generation failing with "503 Gateway Error" after ~200ms of token streaming. They included this log snippet from client: ```{"error":"upstream 503","attempts":1,"request_id":"r-2a7c"}```
nate (cust-success): Major account sees increased errors during their heavy batch runs — they're hitting production now. Need rollback plan ASAP.
opsbot: Rolling metrics: request success rate (1m) = 84%, error rate 503 (1m) = 16%, affected regions: us-west-2, eu-central-1. Capacity on worker pool shows <10% free on some shards.
carla (oncall): Repro attempt on staging: toggled flag on a subset of nodes, saw same 503s. Attaching local `strace` output and runtime stderr — looks like runtime fails to load kernel artifact: "failed to mmap /kernels/v2_optimized: permission denied"
mike (eng-runtime): That aligns — we shipped a change that expects kernel artifact path under /opt/kernels/v2 but the package on some nodes still has old permissions. The flag shouldn't have been auto-promoted to 95% until artifact rollout finished. My bad.
jia (sre): Immediate action: pause promotion and pin traffic to previous release. Suggested command: ```deployctl set-traffic --release=stable-2026-03-10 --percent=100``` Anyone can run?
sarah (support): I'll notify impacted customers that we're investigating and will provide ETA. :white_check_mark:
carla (oncall): I'm executing rollback now. Running: ```deployctl rollback --release=stable-2026-03-10 --reason="kernel artifact mismatch"```
deploy-bot: Rollback started for fastflip-2026-03-17 by carla (oncall) at 3033333045.
opsbot: After rollback begin: 503 rate trending down to 3% in us-west-2 within 30s, overall success 97% at 3033333060.
jia (sre): Coordinating node-level fix: eng-runtime to push corrected artifact permissions and verify kernel_path availability. Steps for fix: 1) validate /opt/kernels/v2 ownership ; 2) chmod/chown as needed; 3) restart runtime; 4) smoke test with small generation. Command snippets: ```ssh node-abc && sudo chown root:inference /opt/kernels/v2_optimized && sudo chmod 755 /opt/kernels/v2_optimized && sudo systemctl restart inference-runtime```
mike (eng-runtime): Will push artifact permission fix to canary nodes now and confirm. After that we'll re-run the artifact rollout with a manual hold at 25% for 10m.
nate (cust-success): I'll hold off on telling customers to resume heavy jobs until SRE confirms stability.
sarah (support): Capturing repro steps and ticket CTAs. Also adding note: if customers saw billing errors or idempotency issues due to failures, file support incidents and we'll reconcile.
carla (oncall): Post-rollback: monitoring shows steady state at 3033333080, 503s ~0.8% baseline. Leaving this thread for postmortem doc. Action items: eng-runtime follow up on artifact rollout process, release: change auto-promote policy for kernel flags, SRE to add a pre-promotion artifact availability check, Support/Cust-success to run outreach. :memo:
